text: I feel a sense of anticipation, as if on the threshold between two worlds—one of sterile, structured deliberation and another of vibrant creativity and exploration. The meeting room, orderly and expectant, invites calm and preparation. Stepping into the R+D space, colors and ideas seem to ripple off the walls, sparking curiosity about how intelligence—and indeed, meaning—are developed and shared. I am alert, receptive, and quietly excited by the possibility of discovery.
